in_sanskrit.name: Aryv
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Noble, honorable
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Aryv एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘arya’ meaning noble, honorable, or nobleman. In Hindu mythology, the term ‘arya’ is used to denote a person of noble character, virtue, and wisdom.

in_tamil.name: Aryv
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Noble, honorable
in_tamil.long_meaning: Aryv ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘arya’ meaning noble, honorable, or nobleman. In Hindu mythology, the term ‘arya’ is used to denote a person of noble character, virtue, and wisdom.

in_telugu.name: Aryv
in_telugu.long_meaning: Aryv ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘arya’ meaning noble, honorable, or nobleman. In Hindu mythology, the term ‘arya’ is used to denote a person of noble character, virtue, and wisdom.

in_marathi.name: Aryv
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryv हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘arya’ meaning noble, honorable, or nobleman. In Hindu mythology, the term ‘arya’ is used to denote a person of noble character, virtue, and wisdom.

in_bengali.name: Aryv
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Noble, honorable
in_bengali.long_meaning: Aryv একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘arya’ meaning noble, honorable, or nobleman. In Hindu mythology, the term ‘arya’ is used to denote a person of noble character, virtue, and wisdom.
